source: Curated for Sunflower from manufacturer datasheets (each checked by an independent second pass on 2026-11-17). Geometry is from dimensioned drawings where stated, otherwise estimated; measure your driver before printing.

geometry_mm.basis: estimated from the scaled side view (+-10 mm)

drivers.geometry_source: B&C product page and outline drawing (https://bcspeakers.com/uploads/products/dataSheetDrawings/2016_07_29_12_53_18_446_15NW76_drawing.png). The drawing dimensions only 393/374/354, depth 177 and flange 16. Scaling the side view gives a motor of roughly 130 mm diameter protruding roughly 50 to 70 mm, so the top plate sits roughly 105 to 125 mm behind the front face. These are estimates, not entered as fields. The front view shows the rear of the driver, so the dust cap and surround cannot be measured. No 3D model is offered.
drivers.price_source: https://www.parts-express.com/B-C-15NW76-15-Professional-Neodymium-Woofer-8-Ohm-294-5985 (out of stock when indexed; Thomann UK GBP 249 in stock: https://www.thomann.co.uk/bc_15nw76_8_ohms.htm)
drivers.notes: Best motor strength here (Bl 25.5, Qes 0.23, EBP 183). Triple-roll surround, double spider, 19 mm winding, Xvar 10 mm, Vas 130 L. Rated only 40 Hz to 2 kHz, which is the weakest top end of the set for a full-vocal-range mid. Recone kit RCK15NW768.

geometry_mm.basis: estimated from the scaled side view (+-10 mm)

drivers.geometry_source: B&C product page and outline drawing (https://bcspeakers.com/uploads/products/dataSheetDrawings/2016_09_08_11_15_08_19_15CL76_drawing.png). Dimensioned: 389/374/353, depth 171, flange 11. Scaling the side view gives a neo slug motor of roughly 100 mm diameter and roughly 45 mm tall at the rear (estimate). The front view shows the rear only. No 3D model is offered.
drivers.status: current: listed on bcspeakers.com with no discontinued note. Sold at Parts Express ($246.18 per search snippet), Target ($217.97) and Sonovente (148.33 EUR ex VAT, in stock).
drivers.notes: Light (3.8 kg), neo inside slug, single spider, triple-roll surround, 19 mm winding, 11 mm gap, Vas 135 L, Xvar 8.5 mm. Rated 40 Hz to 3 kHz. Recone kit RCK15CL768 includes the cone and dust cap and could be measured directly.

geometry_mm.basis: drawing gives motor 150 and depth 165 only

drivers.geometry_source: Faital 8 ohm datasheet and drawing (https://faitalpro.com/products/files/15PR400/8/15PR400_drawing_8.pdf). The 150 mm motor diameter, 165 mm depth and 13.1 mm flange are drawing dimensions. The drawing's front view shows the rear only, and the side view is an exterior view of the basket with no cone section. The info-pack zip contains only PDFs, with no CAD.
drivers.status: Current. The datasheet from faitalpro.com (id=101060100) generates fine and is stamped 'Printed: November 17th, 2026'. That date is when the PDF was generated, not a revision date. Nothing marks the model as discontinued. Parts Express lists 294-1271 at $401.00 according to indexed copies. Whether it is in stock now is unclear: the search results conflict.
drivers.notes: Lowest Le of the set (0.72 mH), Mmd 56.8 g, Vas 248.9 L, Xdamage 15.5 mm, 4-wave accordion polycotton surround, aluminium winding, neo slug, aluminium basket, 3.6 kg. Rated 35 Hz to 4 kHz. Recone kit R3803827.

geometry_mm.basis: older dimensioned drawing and scaled current front view

drivers.geometry_source: The current datasheet drawing gives 388/370/352, depth 161 and 145. Motor diameter 122 and height 58.5 come from the older-revision datasheet drawing (https://www.lautsprechershop.de/pdf/beyma/beyma_15p80nd.pdf, depth 157.5 = 14.5 flange + 84.5 basket + 58.5 motor), so the top plate sits about 99 mm behind the front face on that revision. Dust cap (about 116 mm outer, about 105 mm inner line), cone rim at the inner surround edge (about 304 mm) and surround width (about 27 mm) were measured from the current datasheet's front view, rendered at 600 dpi and scaled to the 388 mm OD. No 3D model is offered.
drivers.status: current. Beyma hosts the current datasheet (revision footer 11/20). Parts Express (253-009) shows it in stock in search results, and Sonovente FR and Soundimports EU also list it. Bax UK lists it as discontinued, which looks specific to that retailer.
drivers.notes: The current datasheet differs from the old one (old: Fs 54, Qes 0.36, Le 1.6, Mms 105). Use the current values given here. 4 in DUO in/out coil, 20 mm winding, 12 mm gap, Xdamage 52 mm p-p, Vas 184 L, Cms 168 um/N, conex spider, cone waterproofed both sides. With the cone-depth upper bound below about 99 mm, this is likely the shallowest cone of the set. Recone kit 15P80Nd-RK.

geometry_mm.basis: dimensioned drawing; cone rim from Sd

drivers.geometry_source: 18 Sound drawing (https://www.eighteensound.it/system/dragonfly/production/2021/01/17/10_30_02_19_15MB700_drawing.JPG). Dimensioned: OD 387, cutout 352 on drawing, motor 200 x 42, depth 167.5 = 4.5 + 121 + 42, so the top plate face is about 125.5 mm behind the front face. The front view shows several concentric rings on the cone, possibly ribs. The innermost circle scales to about 62 mm, smaller than the 75 mm coil, so I could not identify the dust cap and left it null. No CAD is offered.
drivers.status: Current. On the 18 Sound 15NMB420 product page, the 15MB700 is listed as 'Alternative/Current Model: 15MB700', and the 15MB700 product page is still live. Canal Sound & Light (product/15mb700) shows it In stock with a schema offer price of USD 245.95, so the price is confirmed. The same page's tracking data also shows 267.78, which looks like a list or regular price.
drivers.notes: Highest sensitivity of the set (103 dB) and lightest cone (73 g). Ferrite, 9.4 kg shipping. Recommended 90 L at 45 Hz. Rated 45 Hz to 4.3 kHz. A large 200 mm motor sits behind a reversed driver, which matters for the throat side of the plug. Recone kit R15MB700.

geometry_mm.basis: dimensioned drawing and scaled front view

drivers.geometry_source: 18 Sound drawing (https://www.eighteensound.it/system/dragonfly/production/2021/01/18/01_19_13_578_15W700.gif). Dimensioned: motor 200 x 43, depth 168.5 = 4.5 + 121 + 43, so the top plate face is about 125.5 mm behind the front face. Measured from the scaled front view against the 387 OD: dust cap about 100 mm, cone rim at the inner surround edge about 316 mm, surround about 18 mm wide. The roll lines are ambiguous, so the surround width is plus or minus 4 mm. No CAD is offered.
drivers.status: Current. The 8 ohm 15W700 product page on eighteensound.it has no archive or replacement note and offers the drawing GIF and datasheet PDF only (no CAD). Eighteen Sound's 15W500 page lists the 15W700 as its 'Alternative/Current Model'. Thomann (thomannmusic.com) shows it in stock at $233, available since March 2011.
drivers.notes: Datasheet says 'deep profile curvilinear' paper cone with a 'double half-roll' surround (the spec table says M-roll). Heavy (8.5 kg net, ferrite). Vas 217 L, Qts 0.30, EBP 115 Hz, recommended tuning 45 Hz, continuous program power 700 W. Rated 38 Hz to 5 kHz. The drawing gives the cutout as 352 mm and depth as 168.5 mm; the datasheet table says 353 mm and 168 mm. The 4 ohm 15W700 page names the 15W750 as its current alternative; the 8 ohm page has no such note. Do not confuse it with PRV Audio's unrelated 15W700.

geometry_mm.basis: dimensioned drawing and scaled front view

drivers.geometry_source: 18 Sound drawing (https://www.eighteensound.it/system/dragonfly/production/2021/01/17/14_40_14_645_15NMB420.gif). Dimensioned: motor 136 x 45, depth 169.5 = 4.5 + 120 + 45, so the top plate face is about 124.5 mm behind the front face. Measured from the scaled front view against the 387 OD (0.616 mm/px): dust cap about 90 mm, cone rim at the inner surround edge about 316 mm, outer surround about 358 mm, surround about 21 mm wide. Mid-surround diameter of about 337 mm agrees with Sd 900 cm2. No CAD is offered.
drivers.status: Superseded, probably discontinued. The 18 Sound product page is still live but carries the label 'Alternative/Current Model: 15MB700'. It has no explicit discontinued notice. No current retail listing was found for the 15NMB420.
drivers.notes: Matches the spec window very well (neo, Le 0.8, Xmax 6.5, 3.9 kg, rated 40 Hz to 5 kHz), but 18 Sound now points to the 15MB700. Its front-view geometry is the most reliably measured of the set.
